'''Selia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Witch]] who served as a member of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
